entry.author: nzpost
entry.summary:
Learn all you need to know on how to print your first label in eShip. 
 
0:14 - Checklist before we start 
0:34 - Installing and setting up the print app (Windows & Mac instructions) 
2:33 - Configuring how to print each label type in eShip 
2:47 - Printing your first label (Individual & Bulk printing) 
 
Learn more and sign in to your eShip portal here to get started: 
https://www.nzpost.co.nz/business/ecommerce/eship 
 
Tutorial on how to set up the address validation feature on eShip: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O_HVtmyOZCc
